Sentence (English): Remember the days when Dishwashers used to last about 10 years?
Comments (English): [ DOES NOT LAST MORE THAN 2-4 YEARS TOPS! ] || ---------------- || Remember the days when Dishwashers used to last about 10 years? NOT this one. I've seen a lot of complaints online about the same problems. I then moved out of state for a year, using it only intermittently when visiting my home. The sump pump stopped working & once the pump sump is replaced, that usually requires the control panel to also be replaced. The replacements cost approx $685. It was just outside of the 2 year warranty. Fortunately I used my COSTCO VISA to purchase the item from Costco prior to 1/2023, so it was covered by the then-existent additional 2-year warranty. They no longer offer that extended warranty if you purchase the item after 1/23/2023. I managed to receive $685 back, so I will use that to purchase a Bosch that my dishwasher repair guy recommends. He said Bosch has managed to figure out what the problem was with their sump pump and they haven't been having those issues anymore, but KitchenAid continues to break down, unfortunately. As COSTCO members we should be putting KitchenAid on notice of their faulty appliances.

Sentence (English): I'm writing an evaluation of the Bosch Series 500 (SHPM65Z55N) that was installed at my home on 2 March 2023.
Comments (English): [ Patrick New SHPM65Z55N Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I'm writing an evaluation of the Bosch Series 500 (SHPM65Z55N) that was installed at my home on 2 March 2023. I'll address the following aspects the dishwasher, easy of loading, cleaning performance, drying, noise levels, making default settings, and finally areas needing attention. Some of my comments will reference the 52-page Bosch User's Manual. The new Bosch Series 500 dishwasher replaced my 15 year old KitchenAid that failed when the electronic controls failed requiring a costly repair. The old dishwasher set the standards by which I use to judge the new washer. Ease of Loading Loading the Bosch is significantly different from that of my old KitchenAid and will probably new users a month before becoming proficient. I like the Bosch method of loading knives, forks, spoons, etc. in the top rack. It facilitates loading the items in an ordered manner that makes it easy to quickly unload like items for storage in a drawer. I removed the two “baskets” to make room for more dishes and bowls. I haven't missed them. The fact that the Bosch Series 500 dishwasher does not have a dryer heating element is a major plus. Dropping heating element makes it energy efficient and it allows us to place plastic items in the large lower rack without fear that a high temperature coil will damage such items. Cleaning Performance The ability of the Bosch Series 500 dishwasher to effectively clean its contents is superior. It beats that of my old KitchenAid by a mile. Drying We use AutoAir as our default setting that produces satisfactory results. However, we now have a drying cloth handy whenever we unload the washer. Noise Levels The noise produced by this Bosch Series 500 is lower than that of the dishwasher it replaced. The noise from our new Bosch is so low that we depend on its red run light to check its run status. It is noteworthy that noise levels reported by various manufactures in the Consumer Report magazine are not obtained in a standard manner. Thus the manufacture's listed noise levels should be used only to compare levels for different washer models made my the same company. Making Default Settings Without a doubt, this is the most head-scratching effort of learning to use the washers covered by the User's Manual. Anything that could be done to make the process more reader efficient would be useful. Areas Needing Attention The User's Manual is significantly deficient in one area that should be corrected ASAP. That area is the starting procedure after all the default setting have been made and you're starting a new cycle after loading the cleaning agent and the liquid rinse aid. The washer will not start if the user does not pause a period of time between pressing the On/Off button and then pressing the Start button before shutting the washer door within 4-seconds after pressing the Start button. We have determined that it is necessary to pause at least three flashes of the control panel indicator lights before pressing the Start button and then shutting door without hesitation for the washer to start. If the user does not pause between pressing the On/Off and the Start button before shutting the door the red run indicator light will not come on and the washer does not start. The User Manual does not provide user guidance as to how to recover from this situation. Starting all over after pressing the On/Off button does not necessarily reset the washer. It is possible when trying various button pushing sequences after the washer doesn't start and to get a flashing red run indicator light. The section of the User's Manual on page 36 entitled Terminating the wash cycle (Reset) will not correct the flashing red run light situation. Also, following this procedure to recover from the flashing red light situation never results in the display reading 0,01. This can lead the casual user to believe that the washer is broken, It appears that the controls require pauses at some points of the start/recover process. I don't think all needed pauses are identified in the User's Manual.

Sentence (English): I'm writing an evaluation of the Bosch Series 500 (SHPM65Z55N) that was installed at my home on 2 March 2023.
Comments (English): [ Patrick New SHPM65Z55N Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I'm writing an evaluation of the Bosch Series 500 (SHPM65Z55N) that was installed at my home on 2 March 2023. I'll address the following aspects the dishwasher, easy of loading, cleaning performance, drying, noise levels, making default settings, and finally areas needing attention. Some of my comments will reference the 52-page Bosch User's Manual. The new Bosch Series 500 dishwasher replaced my 15 year old KitchenAid that failed when the electronic controls failed requiring a costly repair. The old dishwasher set the standards by which I use to judge the new washer. Ease of Loading Loading the Bosch is significantly different from that of my old KitchenAid and will probably new users a month before becoming proficient. I like the Bosch method of loading knives, forks, spoons, etc. in the top rack. It facilitates loading the items in an ordered manner that makes it easy to quickly unload like items for storage in a drawer. I removed the two "baskets" to make room for more dishes and bowls. I haven't missed them. The fact that the Bosch Series 500 dishwasher does not have a dryer heating element is a major plus. Dropping heating element makes it energy efficient and it allows us to place plastic items in the large lower rack without fear that a high temperature coil will damage such items. Cleaning Performance The ability of the Bosch Series 500 dishwasher to effectively clean its contents is superior. It beats that of my old KitchenAid by a mile. Drying We use AutoAir as our default setting that produces satisfactory results. However, we now have a drying cloth handy whenever we unload the washer. Noise Levels The noise produced by this Bosch Series 500 is lower than that of the dishwasher it replaced. The noise from our new Bosch is so low that we depend on its red run light to check its run status. It is noteworthy that noise levels reported by various manufactures in the Consumer Report magazine are not obtained in a standard manner. Thus the manufacture's listed noise levels should be used only to compare levels for different washer models made my the same company. Making Default Settings Without a doubt, this is the most head-scratching effort of learning to use the washers covered by the User's Manual. Anything that could be done to make the process more reader efficient would be useful. Areas Needing Attention The User's Manual is significantly deficient in one area that should be corrected ASAP. That area is the starting procedure after all the default setting have been made and you're starting a new cycle after loading the cleaning agent and the liquid rinse aid. The washer will not start if the user does not pause a period of time between pressing the On/Off button and then pressing the Start button before shutting the washer door within 4-seconds after pressing the Start button. We have determined that it is necessary to pause at least three flashes of the control panel indicator lights before pressing the Start button and then shutting door without hesitation for the washer to start. If the user does not pause between pressing the On/Off and the Start button before shutting the door the red run indicator light will not come on and the washer does not start. The User Manual does not provide user guidance as to how to recover from this situation. Starting all over after pressing the On/Off button does not necessarily reset the washer. It is possible when trying various button pushing sequences after the washer doesn't start and to get a flashing red run indicator light. The section of the User's Manual on page 36 entitled Terminating the wash cycle (Reset) will not correct the flashing red run light situation. Also, following this procedure to recover from the flashing red light situation never results in the display reading 0,01. This can lead the casual user to believe that the washer is broken, It appears that the controls require pauses at some points of the start/recover process. I don't think all needed pauses are identified in the User's Manual.

Sentence (English): After 18 years of service, we decided to replace a previous GE Profile DW with this one.
Comments (English): [ Replaced a GE dishwasher with a GE ] || ---------------- || After 18 years of service, we decided to replace a previous GE Profile DW with this one. Quality and features were as advertised. This unit provided the features we wanted. We have only used it twice, but it appears to work very well. We self-installed in order to get the quality we wanted. Four bits of feedback worth noting:. 1. When delivered, a pair of deliberate scratches had been made across the front door.This had been done at the factory, prior to boxing. It penetrated the protective film, but we were able to buff out with abrasive pads. 2. Top control design is barely compatible with any cabinet arrangement where countertop overhangs the faceframe (which would be most common) - the exact dimensions of this fit-up should be prominently featured in the product literature. 3. Unless your DW is to be installed in a very oversized cabinet opening, the fit-up with respect to faceframe, countertop, leveling, and mounting bracket installation is the lion's share of the install effort. The dimensional relationship among these features and the door is a challenge to make work. Where the fit is closer (typical), the supplied trim is quite useless - and the rough fit between the tub flange layers made it all but impossible to press the trim on. I had to make my own. 4. Considering wrench access, it makes more sense to install the water supply elbow to the incoming tubing/hose first, then tighten elbow hose-thread connection onto valve assembly later.

Top control design is barely compatible with any cabinet arrangement where countertop overhangs the faceframe (which would be most common) - the exact dimensions of this fit-up should be prominently featured in the product literature. 3. Where the fit is closer (typical), the supplied trim is quite useless - and the rough fit between the tub flange layers made it all but impossible to press the trim on. I had to make my own. 4. Considering wrench access, it makes more sense to install the water supply elbow to the incoming tubing/hose first, then tighten elbow hose-thread connection onto valve assembly later.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher to replace a Kitchenaid that had been slowly failing.
Comments (English): [ Amazing cleaning power and large capacity ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher to replace a Kitchenaid that had been slowly failing. Our new Bosch gets our dishes cleaner than our old dishwasher ever did even when it was new. We have three kids and are big cooks so we ask a lot of our dishwasher and could not be more pleased with its performance. Even things like microwaved-on cheese or tomato soup come off. We worried that the less flexible tine arrangement would mean that this dishwasher would hold less than our old one, but that hasn't been the case. With the adjustable second and third racks, I think it actually holds more. The automatic-open feature works well and I'm glad we chose the model with it. I have heard sometimes those latches fail prematurely so we'll have to watch for that. Overall super happy with this purchase. There are two downsides to be aware of. First, the speed cycle option that is supposed to be 60 minutes is actually 2 hours according to the digital display, so not really that quick. Second, the back of this dishwasher is closed, unlike older or lower-end open-back models, so if you have any obstructions behind it (such as plumbing, in our case), the dishwasher won't be able to be pushed back as far as it should be. I was NOT happy with the installation and am trying to decide whether or not to pay for a plumber to come out and move pipes so it doesn't stick out so far.

We worried that the less flexible tine arrangement would mean that this dishwasher would hold less than our old one, but that hasn't been the case. Sentence (English): Other than an awkward top rack, this is a fine unit.
Comments (English): [ Surprisingly effective at washing dishes, which is the point; and quiet. ] || ---------------- || Other than an awkward top rack, this is a fine unit. Quiet and effective. Our KitchenAid was not washing well and was often leaving a cloud or film on glasses, not to mention breaking down frequently (and it was only ten years old). This GE, though made in China by Haier, which we didn't know at the time, washes extremely effectively. The filter is very, very easy to take out and clean - much better than the KitchenAid system of using a “grinder” which doesn't really work, and which basically pushes food into a grille that then clogs. I like the bottle washer rack, too, and the little “third racks” which can also be used to hold wine glasses in place. The lower rack is very effective for holding LOTS of plates (disclaimer: Corelle which is quite thin) and even those big salad bowl things, but really has no place for small saucers, and cereal bowls are kinda hard to arrange. Top rack is not so good at holding glasses in place in two of the rows, so you have to be gentle pulling it out and putting it back in. It does have three height positions which is good. I'm not so fond of the top-of-door controls which are easy to accidentally press, but I like the automatic mode and the ability to have either top or bottom shut off if desired.

Sentence (English): Our 17-year-old GE dishwasher seized up its discharge pump.
Comments (English): [ Somewhat disappointed with the performance ] || ---------------- || Our 17-year-old GE dishwasher seized up its discharge pump. For the cost of repair why not just buy a new one. I chose this new GE model based on noise level mostly. It is quiet, one often wonders if it is running.at all. In retrospect, if I could have purchased new the identical model I had I would have gone for it in a heartbeat. I miss not having all the controls in front. I had to move this one out about two inches just to see the controls. I never had to use heated drying as opening the door when finished allowed the dishes to be completely dry by morning. The complete cycle took about 57 minutes, the new one takes at least 75 minutes or more. And when leaving the door open overnight there are still lots of undried dishes. The old had two distinct beeps to let you know the wash was complete. Only a faint alert on the new. Stainless steel interior may look nice but it is easy to miss a knife or fork that may have fallen into the bottom. The old had three spinning wash arms, the new only two. Had I not been in such a hurry for a new dishwasher I would have given more thought to comparing the old and the new. There are places around here that refurbish appliances. I will suffer this new one for now but am asking those places to be on the lookout for the model we used to have.

Sentence (English): We have a big family and over the last 20 years, we have been through at least 4 different dishwashers- all different brands and lesser expensive ones at that to save money.
Comments (English): [ Washing dishes has never been easier!  ] || ---------------- || We have a big family and over the last 20 years, we have been through at least 4 different dishwashers- all different brands and lesser expensive ones at that to save money. However, after our last one bit the dust, my husband splurged and bought me this new LG knowing how much I have liked my other LG appliances. This LG dishwasher is right in line with the quality I have come to know from other LG products. After installation, I truly believed that something had been incorrectly installed because I couldn't hear anything upon trying to run the first load. I thought it was not functioning only to learn that it was indeed running! It was that quiet! After hearing all of my old dishwashers moan and grind for years, this LG is so quiet that it doesn't cause any disturbing noise. To top it off, the dishes come out sparkling clean and the tub inside looks fantastic too! I am incredibly impressed with the different features as well including the many different washing cycle options and the extra dry feature. The spray arms inside of the tub are sturdy and the filter is so easy to remove for cleaning. I even love the end of cycle chime/song! When I hear that song, I know that I can be confident that my dishes are clean, sparkling and ready for my family's next meal together. LG, you have made this Mom's days a little easier with your well thought out design and quality in this fantastic appliance! I just simply cannot say enough positive things about it, so, I suppose the only one phrase left to say is, Thank you!

Sentence (English): Our 17-year-old GE dishwasher seized up its discharge pump.
Comments (English): [ Somewhat disappointed with the performance ] || ---------------- || Our 17-year-old GE dishwasher seized up its discharge pump. For the cost of repair why not just buy a new one.I chose this new GE model based on noise level mostly. It is quiet, one often wonders if it is running.at all. In retrospect, if I could have purchased new the identical model I had I would have gone for it in a heartbeat.I miss not having all the controls in front. I had to move this one out about two inches just to see the controls. I never had to use heated drying as opening the door when finished allowed the dishes to be completely dry by morning. The complete cycle took about 57 minutes, the new one takes at least 75 minutes or more. And when leaving the door open overnight there are still lots of undried dishes.The old had two distinct beeps to let you know the wash was complete. Only a faint alert on the new. Stainless steel interior may look nice but it is easy to miss a knife or fork that may have fallen into the bottom. The old had three spinning wash arms, the new only two. Had I not been in such a hurry for a new dishwasher I would have given more thought to comparing the old and the new.There are places around here that refurbish appliances. I will suffer this new one for now but am asking those places to be on the lookout for the model we used to have.

The cutlery tray at the top is really handy and space saving. It is VERY Quiet, you won't notice that the machine is running so feel free to put it on at night! If you like to save a bit of energy, you can also use the app to turn it on during the day (solar power), you can do this remotely at work. It also cleans really well. No more pre-rinsing the dishes, just chuck them all in the dishwasher and you have sparkling clean dishes in couple of hours. It works just so fantastically that you won't regret every penny you spent on this machine.

Sentence (English): I've been waiting several months to write this review, and the verdict is firm.
Comments (English): [ Worse than a useless dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I've been waiting several months to write this review, and the verdict is firm. These dishwashers are junk. I've had a lot of dishwashers over the years, even budget models do a better job of getting dishes clean. This is worse than leaving dishes dirty -- in many cases, it makes your dishes even MORE dirty -- it's like it collects the sediment, sprays it deep inside of glasses and containers, then bakes it on with the drying feature! I've tried different settings, such storm wash, heavy, and high-temp wash, and they don't help much. If anything, I'm just using more energy and creating more wear and tear with these settings. I've been finding that there about only 4 locations on the racks that "might" help in getting glasses and cups clean, and even then, there is no guarantee. Do I have to rinse everything off thoroughly before putting dishes into the dishwasher? If so, then what is the point? Very disappointed. We have the Samsung clothing washer and dryer, and they hit a home run with those, so I thought the dishwasher would be safe bet. Boy was I wrong. One of the worst appliances I ever bought. (And to make things worse, Lowes installed it, and they didn't hook it up correctly and I had a major water leak then went into my basement and I had to clean it up and fix the leak myself.)

Comments (English): [ It's just OK ] || ---------------- || We bought this to replace a 21-year-old GE dishwasher that was great quality. This dishwasher is just ok. The dishes get so hot it's too hot to touch, yet somehow they (and the machine itself) are still wet. The fact that the machine stays wet can be a problem for mold and mildew, so I leave it open after each load to air dry. This alone would cause me to not recommended this product. Other than that everything else about it is kind of neither good nor horrible. I wouldn't recommend this product; I would hope there's something better out there for the price.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher would be terrific if it didn't totally die once a year.
Comments (English): [ Mother board only lasts a year ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher would be terrific if it didn't totally die once a year. The mother board has needed to be replaced twice - a year apart each time. The guy at the appliance parts store said he “sells a ton” of these boards for this dishwasher. The boards cost $150. And now in 2023, GE won't allow the parts sellers to sell the replacement boards to consumers unless the old board is also returned, otherwise they charge an additional $55! They made a faulty product that they want back… I had hoped it was to study their mistake and make improvements… But now I have learned that the control panel is THE REASON why the other boards are shorting out… so if you don't ALSO replace the control panel, the mother board will fry within a year. So I think GE demands the mother board be returned so they can refurbish it and sell it back to us to fix their faulty product! There should be a recall on this dishwasher with a complete replacement of mother board and control panel.

Sentence (English): These days, all houses have built-in dishwashers, but I actually removed them when I was renovating my house.
Comments (English): [ I am very satisfied. ] || ---------------- || These days, all houses have built-in dishwashers, but I actually removed them when I was renovating my house. I didn't trust the dishwasher. However, I used it while living abroad last year and it was really good. I have more time in my life. I thought I should buy a dishwasher first when I go to Korea, but when I actually came here, it was annoying to take out the sink and put the dishwasher in, so I was worried, and luckily I was able to experience it as a member of the experience group. I was worried that it might be too small for 6 people or that it might look cramped if I put it on the sink. It was big, but it was better than I thought when I put it on the sink. The inside is not big, but the space is well-designed and well-organized so that you can put dishes in every nook and cranny, so it holds quite a lot. I only use it once a day in the evening. For your information, we are a family of four who eat three meals a day. I wash pots, plastic, and wood separately. The programs are divided into strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, and quick. Normally, I wash dishes with the standard course, and the time is 59 minutes, the power consumption is 0.63kWh, and the water used is 8.3L. Washing is 55c, rinse-rinse-rinse (70c), and residual heat drying is possible. Although it dries, it is essential to leave the door open after the course is finished. The sound of the dishwasher running is really quiet. It is quieter than a washing machine. The most important washing function. It cleans very well. Rinse and put in the larva once. It is a process to remove food residue and oil well. That's why it washes cleanly. I'm satisfied. I'm satisfied with the washing noise, storage course, and design. I recommend it to those who find it difficult to build. It's also very convenient to use. It gives me more freedom in my life. I just feel good. I highly recommend it. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much bigger than I thought. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a little bigger. The packaging is well done with Styrofoam. There are a lot of components inside. Since there is no need for separate installation, you can use it anywhere with space and drainage where you can plug in the power cord. The power cord is short, so the outlet needs to be close. There are 5 modes: standard, strong, eco, and rapid steam. You can choose the mode you want and use it. There is also a reservation function. The rapid function can be washed quickly in 30 minutes. The washing is done with 72 degree Celsius high-temperature water, and the high-pressure water rotates 360 degrees up and down in two stages, so it washes away not only grease, but also red pepper powder, rice paste, etc. cleanly, as if you washed the dishes by hand. It is said that there is also a dish storage function with 72-hour air circulation. However, the function seems to be scary in terms of electricity bill. Also, it only uses 5 liters of water, which saves a lot more water than washing dishes by hand, so it also reduces water waste. The dish rack has wheels so you can put it in and take it out smoothly, and there is an LED lamp on the top of the dishwasher, so when you open the door after washing, the light comes on, allowing you to take out the dishes even in the dark. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water supply is drained by pressing the steam sterilization button and the reservation button at the same time for 3 seconds. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. I haven't tried putting dishes in and washing it yet, but I just tried it, and the water flow is really strong. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water supply is drained by pressing the steam sterilization button and the reservation button at the same time for 3 seconds. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. I haven't tried putting dishes in and washing it yet, but I just tried it, and the water flow is really strong. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ Good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much bigger than I thought. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a little bigger. The packaging is well done with Styrofoam. There are a lot of components inside. Since there is no need for separate installation, you can use it anywhere with space and drainage where you can plug in the power cord. The power cord is short, so the outlet needs to be close. There are 5 modes: standard, strong, eco, and rapid steam. You can choose the mode you want and use it. There is also a reservation function. The rapid function can be washed quickly in 30 minutes. The washing is done with 72 degree Celsius high-temperature water, and the high-pressure water rotates 360 degrees up and down in two stages, so it washes away not only grease, but also red pepper powder, rice paste, etc. cleanly, as if you washed the dishes by hand. It is said that there is also a dish storage function with 72-hour air circulation. However, the function seems to be scary in terms of electricity bill. Also, it only uses 5 liters of water, which saves a lot more water than washing dishes by hand, so it also reduces water waste. The dish rack has wheels so you can put it in and take it out smoothly, and there is an LED lamp on the top of the dishwasher, so when you open the door after washing, the light comes on, allowing you to take out the dishes even in the dark. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water supply is drained by pressing the steam sterilization button and the reservation button at the same time for 3 seconds. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. I haven't tried putting dishes in and washing it yet, but I just tried it, and the water flow is really strong. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ Good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much bigger than I thought. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a little bigger. The packaging is well done with Styrofoam. There are a lot of components inside. Since there is no need for separate installation, you can use it anywhere with space and drainage where you can plug in the power cord. The power cord is short, so the outlet needs to be close. There are 5 modes: standard, strong, eco, and rapid steam. You can choose the mode you want and use it. There is also a reservation function. The rapid function can be washed quickly in 30 minutes. The washing is done with 72 degree Celsius high-temperature water, and the high-pressure water rotates 360 degrees up and down in two stages, so it washes away not only grease, but also red pepper powder, rice paste, etc. cleanly, as if you washed the dishes by hand. It is said that there is also a dish storage function with 72-hour air circulation. However, the function seems to be scary in terms of electricity bill. Also, it only uses 5 liters of water, which saves a lot more water than washing dishes by hand, so it also reduces water waste. The dish rack has wheels so you can put it in and take it out smoothly, and there is an LED lamp on the top of the dishwasher, so when you open the door after washing, the light comes on, allowing you to take out the dishes even in the dark. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water supply is drained by pressing the steam sterilization button and the reservation button at the same time for 3 seconds. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. I haven't tried putting dishes in and washing it yet, but I just tried it, and the water flow is really strong. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ Good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much bigger than I thought. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a little bigger. The packaging is well done with Styrofoam. There are a lot of components inside. Since there is no need for separate installation, you can use it anywhere with space and drainage where you can plug in the power cord. The power cord is short, so the outlet needs to be close. There are 5 modes: standard, strong, eco, and rapid steam. You can choose the mode you want and use it. There is also a reservation function. The rapid function can be washed quickly in 30 minutes. The washing is done with 72 degree Celsius high-temperature water, and the high-pressure water rotates 360 degrees up and down in two stages, so it washes away not only grease, but also red pepper powder, rice paste, etc. cleanly, as if you washed the dishes by hand. It is said that there is also a dish storage function with 72-hour air circulation. However, the function seems to be scary in terms of electricity bill. Also, it only uses 5 liters of water, which saves a lot more water than washing dishes by hand, so it also reduces water waste. The dish rack has wheels so you can put it in and take it out smoothly, and there is an LED lamp on the top of the dishwasher, so when you open the door after washing, the light comes on, allowing you to take out the dishes even in the dark. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water supply is drained by pressing the steam sterilization button and the reservation button at the same time for 3 seconds. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. I haven't tried putting dishes in and washing it yet, but I just tried it, and the water flow is really strong. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ Good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much bigger than I thought. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a little bigger. The packaging is well done with Styrofoam. There are a lot of components inside. Since there is no need for separate installation, you can use it anywhere with space and drainage where you can plug in the power cord. The power cord is short, so the outlet needs to be close. There are 5 modes: standard, strong, eco, and rapid steam. You can choose the mode you want and use it. There is also a reservation function. The rapid function can be washed quickly in 30 minutes. The washing is done with 72 degree Celsius high-temperature water, and the high-pressure water rotates 360 degrees up and down in two stages, so it washes away not only grease, but also red pepper powder, rice paste, etc. cleanly, as if you washed the dishes by hand. It is said that there is also a dish storage function with 72-hour air circulation. However, the function seems to be scary in terms of electricity bill. Also, it only uses 5 liters of water, which saves a lot more water than washing dishes by hand, so it also reduces water waste. The dish rack has wheels so you can put it in and take it out smoothly, and there is an LED lamp on the top of the dishwasher, so when you open the door after washing, the light comes on, allowing you to take out the dishes even in the dark. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water supply is drained by pressing the steam sterilization button and the reservation button at the same time for 3 seconds. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. I haven't tried putting dishes in and washing it yet, but I just tried it, and the water flow is really strong. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. I haven't tried putting dishes in and washing it yet, but I just tried it, and the water flow is really strong. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ Good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much bigger than I thought. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a little bigger. The packaging is well done with Styrofoam. There are a lot of components inside. Since there is no need for separate installation, you can use it anywhere with space and drainage where you can plug in the power cord. The power cord is short, so the outlet needs to be close. There are 5 modes: standard, strong, eco, and rapid steam. You can choose the mode you want and use it. There is also a reservation function. The rapid function can be washed quickly in 30 minutes. The washing is done with 72 degree Celsius high-temperature water, and the high-pressure water rotates 360 degrees up and down in two stages, so it washes away not only grease, but also red pepper powder, rice paste, etc. cleanly, as if you washed the dishes by hand. It is said that there is also a dish storage function with 72-hour air circulation. However, the function seems to be scary in terms of electricity bill. Also, it only uses 5 liters of water, which saves a lot more water than washing dishes by hand, so it also reduces water waste. The dish rack has wheels so you can put it in and take it out smoothly, and there is an LED lamp on the top of the dishwasher, so when you open the door after washing, the light comes on, allowing you to take out the dishes even in the dark. It is said that arranging the dishes facing each other from left to right when washing allows for more effective washing. It is also said that if you rinse the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, you can wash them more cleanly. I feel good because I think the difficult dishwashing will be much easier. There are things you must keep in mind before using it. The water inlet is on the top of the product, and you can use the water shelf to fill it with water. At this time, make sure that the product is turned on. A faucet shape appears on the time display window. Check this and fill it with water. There is a water level sensor, so when the water level is full, an alarm will sound and the faucet shape will disappear. Then, stop the water supply and operate it. The most important checkpoint is to fill the water with the power turned on! And use a detergent specifically for dishwashers! Remember these two things. You have to keep pressing the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water supply is drained by pressing the steam sterilization button and the reservation button at the same time for 3 seconds. However, this function is used when moving the product when not in use for a long time, so use it carefully. I haven't tried putting dishes in and washing it yet, but I just tried it, and the water flow is really strong. It's quite noisy, and the bottom of the sink vibrates, so I think it wouldn't be bad to use a noise mat. I will add a review after washing the dishes. The usage and operation method are not difficult, but even if you know how to operate it, I recommend that you read the manual carefully and use it. I will add a review after use. First of all, the vibration and noise were reduced when I put the dishes in and turned it. I stir-fried the chicken ribs and put them in after larvae only with water. It was difficult to arrange the dishes as instructed, so I stacked them with the bottom facing down. I thought it would take a long time for the regular one, so I did it quickly. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. But it smells like chicken ribs. Is the smell a detergent problem? After washing, I checked the dishwasher. There was chicken galbi oil on both corners in front of the door and a rubber packing on the bottom of the door. There was a lot of oil here as well, so I removed the rubber packing and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Sentence (English): This does a great job of washing dishes.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 300 Series ] || ---------------- || This does a great job of washing dishes. It has what's called a 60 minute cycle, but when it's turned on, it always shows more than one hour. Not a problem. It's billed as an extremely quiet machine. It's not noisy or troublesome, but it's not as quiet as I was expecting. It's clear that a lot of soundproofing is included in the walls, as there's not as much space inside as I was expecting. The flatwear holders on the side of the lower drawer don't clip on very tightly, but there's the third (top) drawer to take care of them if you want. The wine glasses holders flip up and down, which is good, but our wine glasses don't fit in them very well; I had to make the stem notches bigger by cutting away at them or the glasses flop over. Also, even though there are three slots per holder for three glasses, they are too close together. The bases of our smallish wine glasses are too big and we can only get two in each. But it cleans great!

Comments (English): [ Not Happy ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher to replace a Whirlpool I got tired of fixing. The online reviews looked like this was a good dishwasher. Lowe's didn't have one in the store to look at so I purchased it sight unseen. Mistake. The racks are designed mainly for plates and saucers. There is very little space for bowls and serving dishes. There is no space for casserole dishes. I can only fit about 2/3 as many dishes in this Bosch that I could in the Whirlpool. The dishwasher has 6 cycles and a sanitize option. The three cycles that can have a sanitize option take between 2:30 and 2:45 to run. There is an express wash that takes 50 min but you can't add the sanitize option which would take it to 1 hour. I rinse my dishes before putting them in the dishwasher so these cycle times are excessive. The plastic baskets for the utensils are always covered with water drops at the end of the 2:45 wash.

But, my Bosch 500 is a fabulous machine. Just as the instructions say, just remove chunks of food from your dishes and let the machine work it's magic. I only wash ever 3-4mdays and I have found I can use cascade crystals soap w/o any finishing product and I've never not had sparkling clean glassware and fully clean plates and silverware. The feature I love the best is the auto-dry which kicks the door open when done washing! I use delayed wash setting to allow washing in the middle of the night (the unit is so silent they have a red light that shines on the floor to let you know it's running) and by the time I get up everything (even the plastic) is dry but at way less energy useage vs having the dishwasher dry them. So, maybe you need more bells and whistles, but I find this washer fantastic for what I need.

Sentence (English): I replaced my basic model Bosch dishwasher with this model (SHPM78Z55N) when it finally gave out on me.
Comments (English): [ I love, love, love this dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I replaced my basic model Bosch dishwasher with this model (SHPM78Z55N) when it finally gave out on me. It was 25 years old, so I already have great faith in the quality of the Bosch brand! This machine cleans even better than the one I replaced. I scrape the food off, and in the dishes go, with no rinsing, and they come out sparkling every time. I don't use a rinse aid and they are completely dry with exception of a few of the plastic items. It took a short time to get used to this new loading pattern, but once I did, it's working fine. I really like the silverware on the upper 3rd rack. I group silverware together and can just grab a handful and drop it in the proper place in my silverware drawer. No more sorting the clean silver! Yay! The cons: I am used to using the extra layer little shelf on the middle rack, but this one drops down instead of lifting up, so getting short items under to load and unload is a bit of a challenge. Huge disappointment: the stainless exterior door. I've tried everything and I can't keep it streak free. It always looks bad. I'm at the point that I've just had to accept that I won't be able to get it clean and ignore it. With all the smudge-proof stainless on the market, I don't understand this impossible finish. Other than these 2 items, I very highly recommend this dishwasher!

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher in February 2023 in store.
Comments (English): [ I wouldn't buy it again ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in February 2023 in store. Promoted by the seller as a reliable product guaranteed by a European manufacturer, it was delivered within the agreed times. Set for water hardness and use of rinse aid, I did the first washes. All good, except that the internal walls of the machine remain completely wet at the end of the program. The dishes are dry, but a layer of water droplets remains on the walls. Bosch Customer Care reassures me that this is not due to a malfunction of the dishwasher and at my insistence they confirm that the machine is designed to do this and that they are sorry for my disappointment. At this point, I will resign myself to keeping the door open after each wash to at least avoid unpleasant odors due to stagnant water in a closed environment. The fact remains that European reliability has failed, both in the evaluation of the product and in the after-sales assistance of this brand. Finally, I apologize for the length of this review, I hope it can be useful to the next one and I confirm I would never buy this product again.

Sentence (English): We bought our Cafe dishwasher last month.
Comments (English): [ Great appliance with a few quirks ] || ---------------- || We bought our Cafe dishwasher last month. It is a huge upgrade over our 20 year old dishwasher we had. The pluses: it's super quiet. You can hardly tell when it's running, even when you're in the kitchen. It cleans the dishes quite well. I love the spot for water bottles. We clean a half dozen a week so we love that feature. The look is high end, clean lines, no clutter with all the buttons out of site when the door is closed. There are a few small quirks with it: you can't use the upper silverware rack and wash water bottles at the same time. We had to remove the silverware rack in order to have enough room to wash a standard Nalgene 32oz water bottle. The machine also makes random beeping noises. Sentence (English): I have washed dishes by hand for any number of years and enjoyed it, and have not had room for a countertop dishwasher for the past 15 years either.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Series 4 Bench Disk Machine ] || ---------------- || I have washed dishes by hand for any number of years and enjoyed it, and have not had room for a countertop dishwasher for the past 15 years either. Now that I've moved to a new apartment with a bigger kitchen, I took the plunge and haven't regretted it. Easy to install and unexpectedly holds a lot. Sure, you may have to fill the machine several times after a dinner if you want everything washed, but it's the same thing. The machine is quiet and has simple functions. Possibly it's a bit tricky to get plates and oblong wide things in, but I'm super happy with my purchase and really recommend the product
Comments (Original): [ Bosch Serie 4 Bänkdiskmaskin ] || ---------------- || Jag har diskat för hand hur många år som helst och trivts med det och har inte heller haft plats för en bänkdiskmaskin de senaste 15 åren. Visst, man får kanske får fylla maskinen flera gånger efter en middag om man vill ha allt diskat, men det är ju sak samma. Maskinen är tyst och har enkla funktioner. Möjligen är det lite trixigt att få in tallriks och avlånga breda saker, men jag är supernöjd med mitt köp och rekommenderar verkligen produkten

Sentence (English): One of the most annoying chores in the house is washing dishes, so I wanted a dishwasher~~~ and just in time!
Comments (English): One of the most annoying chores in the house is washing dishes, so I wanted a dishwasher~~~ and just in time! I got a great opportunity to use it! First, rocket delivery! The installer had to visit, so it took two days after I ordered. They texted me the delivery date and called me. First, they asked me to send them a picture of the faucet before delivery, but since my faucet is attached to the wall, they said I needed a separate part, and since the company didn't provide the part, the installer had to buy it and bring it, so I had to pay an additional 50,000 won. The installer came and installed it very kindly. The structure of my house made it a bit tricky to install, but he was so kind and attentive, so I was really grateful! He demonstrated to me that the dishwasher was working well and gave me simple instructions on how to use it. After installation, I didn't have much to wash, so I tried a little bit! Oh, it didn't work~~~ An error message popped up, so I checked the manual and it said that it pops up when there's not enough water! My husband came and saw that the dishwasher had been installed, so I moved the location a bit, but at that time, the hose that goes in got pressed down and an error occurred. Fortunately, I checked before requesting after-sales service, so I straightened the hose that was pressed down, and the dishes were washed cleanly. Comments (Original): 1.使用地点，广东肇庆，常用餐具为骨瓷，油污程度一般，毕竟广东人的饮食以清淡为主，但木质筷子，饭锅和炒锅也会放进去。2.洁净程度，我对把碗洗干净这一块还是有点小强迫症的，一家三口，以分层洗为主，刚开始用日常洗，效果并不让我满意，洗后饭锅和饭勺会有一两颗饭粒残留，后面换强力洗，完美解决，多次使用下来暂时没试过洗不干净的，强力洗已经满足需求，所以其他模式就没有再试了。3.干燥，程序结束后碗和机器内壁基本是没有水珠的，但碗篮会有水珠，但可接受。4.售前和售后，没问题，大品牌的销售服务该有的都有，速度也很快。5.消毒和存储暂时没有使用过，我洗完就会把碗放好，也有专门的消毒柜，所以对我来说意义不大。6.安装，没有预留位置，也不想改造橱柜，所以直接放洗衣机上面，刚开始担心洗碗机会移位或掉下来，但使用下来还是很稳的
