Sentence (English): Nice looking dishwasher.
Comments (English): Nice looking dishwasher. I was a little worried about the residue of the rinse aid, so I bought the dishwashing powder separately. The dishes are less oily, 5 grams of dishwashing powder, standard washing, drying for 1 hour, the washing noise is not loud, it is quieter than the washing machine, and it is almost unnoticeable when the kitchen door is closed. The washing is very clean and bright, and the dishes are not. Water droplets remain. There will be a small amount of water residue in the water nozzle, which should be normal. The water quality in this area is good. If there is still slight scale without filtering, set the water softener salt of the dishwasher to H2 level and buy a bag of water softener salt. This large bag of water softener salt is enough for a long time. I used it for a week for the first time, three times a day. Although the water efficiency is level 5, the water consumption and electricity consumption are not large. The experience of using the dishwasher is quite good. Hope it can be used, especially the mechanical properties of the door. The fly in the ointment: the dishwasher is white, but the power cord is black, the outlet pipe and the water inlet pipe are gray, more or less exposed, especially the black power cord, set off by the white tiles, looks a bit awkward . Even for white goods, why can't the power cord and water inlet and outlet pipes be replaced with white ones, and the cost may not be much higher. In addition to the quality of the product itself, the basic beauty and harmony still need to be considered.
Comments (Original): 洗碗机造型不错。有点担心光亮剂残留，单独购买了洗碗粉。碗碟油污少，5克洗碗粉，标准洗，烘干1小时，洗涤噪音不大，比洗衣机的声音要小，关着厨房门基本注意不到，洗得非常干净，光亮，碗碟没有残留水滴。出水喷头那会有少量的水残余，应属于正常情况吧。本地区的水质较好，如果不过滤仍有轻微水垢，将洗碗机的软水盐设置为h2级，买了袋软水盐，这大一袋软水盐够用很久了。初次使用一周，一日三次，虽说水效是5级，但用水量和用电量不大，洗碗机的使用体验挺好。希望能够用得住，尤其是门的机械性能。美中不足之处：洗碗机是白色的，可是电源线是黑色的，出水管和进水管的是灰色的，多少都会露出一点，尤其是黑色的电源线，白色的瓷砖衬托着，看起来有点别扭。即是白色家电，为什么不能把电源线和进出水管都换成白色的，成本也不见得会多多少。除了产品本身的质量，基本的美观与和谐还是要考虑的。

Sentence (English): This morning they have come to deliver the dishwashers, we had disassembled the door but there were two other screws that the two delivery men could not/wanted to disassemble.
Comments (English): [ Service delivery and installation of large appliances unfortunate. ] || ---------------- || This morning they have come to deliver the dishwashers, we had disassembled the door but there were two other screws that the two delivery men could not/wanted to disassemble. They left me the new one in the corridor and they left, without giving me the option to return it… they were very fast. Sure, according to the fine print of the rules they are right, but for a client this rigidity and this rush to drop everything and leave is not good at all. We do not change electrical appliances every day like your installers. You can foresee these situations, which according to the gentlemen who have come to deliver seem quite usual. If your teams had a suitable screwdriver, in 2 minutes they would have solved everything and avoided other trips, CO2 emissions, anger…. I have expressly asked those who have delivered the dishwashers to return it, but they have told me that it was already in the system and that if I wanted a return I had to request it from the application as of Monday... I feel cheated and powerless to react. For a customer this experience is very bad. I have understood that Amazon is not organized for deliveries of large appliances, that you can only do what is easy and usual, and there is no capacity for more. I understand that it is the logic of efficiency, but then you do not have to "sell" service.
Comments (Original): [ Servicio entrega y instalacion grandes electrodomensticos lamentable. ] || ---------------- || Esta mañana han venido a entregar las lavavajillas, habíamos desmontado la puerta pero habían otros dos tornillos que los dos señores de la entrega no han podido/querido desmontar. Me han dejado la nueva en el pasillo y se han ido, sin darme la opción de devolver ya … iban muy de prisa. Seguro que según la letra pequeña de las normas tienen razón, pero para un cliente esta rigidez y esta prisa de dejar todo y marcharse no es nada bueno.Nosotros no hacemos cambio de electrodomésticos cada día como vuestros instaladores. Podéis prever estas situaciones, que según los señores que han venido a entregar parecen bastante usuales. Si vuestros equipos llevaran un destornillador apropiado, en 2' habrian solucionado todo y evitado otros viajes, emision de CO2, enfados …He pedido expresamente a los que han entregado las lavavajillas de devolverla, pero me han dicho que ya estaba en el sistema y que si quería devolución tenia que solicitarla desde la aplicación a partir del lunes … me siento engañado y sin poder de reacción. Para un cliente esta experiencia es muy mala.He comprendido que Amazon no esta organizada para entregas de grandes electrodomésticos, que solo podéis hacer lo fácil y usual, y no hay capacidad para más.Comprendo que es la lógica de la eficiencia, pero entonces no tenéis que “vender” servicio.

Sentence (English): The kitchen has not been renovated yet, so I connected it myself.
Comments (English): The kitchen has not been renovated yet, so I connected it myself. After a period of trial use, Haier appliances are all in my house. I trust this brand. The offline after-sales service is very good. Most of the time, if there is a problem, I just replace it without repairing it. I don’t know about it online. Before buying, the customer service was very enthusiastic, but after buying it, it was normal. I just said that it is much colder in comparison. It goes without saying that if you buy a big one or not a small one, you can wash it once a day if you have a small number of people. , The pot and the pot cover always feel that they take up too much space and are not easy to place. The biggest flaw is that the chopstick cage is inconvenient to place chopsticks, and it can only be lowered. Customer service, the customer service said that the chopsticks cannot exceed 23 cm, so I can’t use my previous chopsticks, and then I want to buy some shorter ones. As a result, all the chopsticks are 23.5 to 24 cm long, and only children’s chopsticks are 19 cm. Therefore, the design of this place is a flaw. The glass was cracked after a strong wash. Before buying it, I considered the drying method. The hot drying will definitely be dry, but considering the electricity and time-consuming, I usually wash it when I don’t use the dishwasher. There are also water stains in the bowl after washing. Although it will not be dried if the door is opened automatically, but because the inner wall of the tableware is dry after washing in 60 to 70 degrees of water, it is no problem not to dry it. If you have to dry it You can also turn on the drying function, but I have never used it once, and I don’t think it is necessary for the cleaning ability: the quick wash is a taste, it can’t be cleaned at all, and the most used is the daily wash of more than 68 minutes, and there are still individual washes. Dirty places, one and a half hours of strong washing will be cleaner
Comments (Original): 厨房还没装修完，我自己动手接上了，试用了一段时间，家里都是海尔电器，信赖这个牌子，线下售后很好，出了问题大部分时候只换不修，线上不清楚，买之前客服很是热情，买完后就一般了，我只是说对比起来冷淡很多，买大不买小不用多说，人少可以攒一天一次洗，摆放还是需要多摸索，盘子碗没问题，锅和锅盖总感觉太占地方不太好摆，最大的缺陷是这个筷子笼，摆筷子不方便，而且只能放下层，摆好后那个出水的摆臂总是打上筷子，很烦躁，问客服，客服说筷子不能超23厘米，所以说我以前的筷子都不能用了，然后想买一些短点的，结果一搜所有筷子长度都是23.5到24厘米的，只有儿童筷子是19厘米，所以这个地方设计是个缺陷，玻璃杯用了一次强力洗洗裂了一个，买之前考虑过干燥方式，热烘干肯定会比较干，但考虑到费电又费时，平时不用洗碗机的时候洗完碗里也是有水渍，自动开门的话虽然不烘干，但因为是六七十度的水洗完后开盖晾一下餐具内壁都是干的，所以不烘干也没问题，如果非要烘干一下也可以点烘干功能，不过我一次也没用过，觉得没必要清洁能力：速洗是个鸡肋，根本洗不干净，用的最多的就是68多分钟的日常洗，还是会有个别洗不干净的地方，一个半小时的强力洗会更干净

Sentence (English): Costco experience was great (price, customer service, 3 months no questions asked return policy & 2-year warranty).
Comments (English): [ Costco is great – Dishwasher so. so ] || ---------------- || Costco experience was great (price, customer service, 3 months no questions asked return policy & 2-year warranty). The dishwasher is so. so. The noise level (decibels) of this unit is no better than the 10-year-old Kenmore (made by Whirlpool) it replaced. The folks at Whirlpool all need hearing aids if they think this thing is quiet. The dishwasher makes a buzzing noise from the area near the pump. We went through 3 of these and they all made the same noise. Internet searches seem to indicate that this is considered “normal” by Whirlpool (the maker of KitchenAid). We finally decided to do our own fix. We kept the insulation blanket from the old dishwasher and used it to add more sound deadening to the area behind and below the kick plate of the dishwasher. That modification substantially decreased the buzzing level and we have decided to keep it… at least for now. We really like the rack system and the dishes do get clean and dry. We also installed the white curved handle and white kick plate from the old Kenmore dishwasher. Those modifications really jazzed up the look. If you have a house with an open kitchen design you do NOT want this dishwasher without adding more sound insulation behind and below the kick panel. We are giving this dishwasher a qualified recommendation based on our experience.

I should have taken my own advice.

We'd heard great things about it and I was very pleased with it for many months. Then, the dishes on the bottom started not to clean entirely. We fiddled around until we found the problem: the bottom rack would not stay on track. It fell when fully loaded. just dishes and bowls. not pots or pans. With the rack off track, the bottom spinner would jam. So we called for a repair or at least a suggestion. A repair person came and put new wheels. which looked just like the old ones. onto the rack. No, the problem is not yet solved. We have to frequently scrub the unclean dishes by hand. Yes, we've tried different ways to load the rack, but honestly, it shouldn't be a chore just to load and reload dishes to check if the spinner can spin. So that is our complaint. Otherwise, the dishwasher is great, quiet and the top rack dishes come out sparkling!

Sentence (English): Why did I buy this great thing now?
Comments (English): Why did I buy this great thing now? When I eat one meal, I spend an hour at the sink cleaning up after the dishes, but that time is cut by more than half. Built-in construction for 12 people. Since the lower cabinet had a 60cm standard cabinet, it was relatively simple to install, just adjusting the baseboard. The interior consists of three pockets. The first tier can be used to place spoons, forks, ladles, etc. The second tier can be used to place rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, and glass cups, and the last 3 tiers can be used to place bulky and heavy pots, frying pans, large plates, etc. It's really convenient because it seats 12 people and can easily be cleaned even if a lot of dishes fit in it. When there are not many dishes, place them only in the bottom drawer and perform a spot wash. I searched for dishwasher-safe containers and found that stainless steel or glass were good, so I cooked with a stainless steel pan and ran it in the dishwasher, and it cleaned well. Even deep pots are cleaned thoroughly, even to the inside. When cleaning is complete, the door opens by itself, and if you sleep with it wide open overnight, the inside is well dried the next morning. Comments (English): [ Great refrigerator but icemakers are marginal ] || ---------------- || I bought this refrigerator June 2022. The refrigerator itself has been great, but both the in-door icemaker and the craft ice maker have been marginal at best. After a call to LG service, unplugging the refrigerator produced an error code for which they scheduled a service call. However, about 4 days later, they sent a text instructing me to try reseting the icemaker again, and this time it worked. I don't have much faith that this will be a permanent fix given the craft icemaker history.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher works great and is nearly silent.
Comments (English): [ 3rd row is very functional! LOOK! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher works great and is nearly silent. We still can't believe how quiet the unit is. One thing about the installation is the water inlet is the size of a garden hose and not a 3/8 fitting. I did have to go back to the hardware store and purchase an installation hose kit that included the particular 90° fitting. My cabinet is a little short for the unit and all of the insulation that surrounds the exterior. There is a perforated hump area that I had to remove per instructions and the unit slid in easily on the dishwasher plastic tray. This tray has a lip on 3 sides that if there is ever a leak, it directs the water toward the front and you would see it on the floor in front of the unit. Slightly raising the legs for the irregularity of the floor and this plastic tray may have contributed to the tight fit with that extra little portion of insulation. As far as the function of this dishwasher it is great. I had coffee cups with tea residue/ stains and this dishwasher cleaned it off! The 3rd row is the reason I purchased this unit over others. It's very practical you can put cups and glasses on the top shelf! It has 2 horizontal rotating wash tubes that really get the inside of your cups and glasses on that top shelf clean. I like the top shelf silverware tray too with individual support for knives. I am able to keep my steak knives separate from the normal silverware which will help keep them sharp. The silverware basket has removable top inserts. I found it tedious placing every handle in its own slot in the standard silverware basket and these are easily removed. Unlike many dishwashers these days, there is a heated dry along with a fan heated dry! I have no regrets and very happy with my purchase. The cleaning, functionality, layout of the tines to support the dishes, and how quiet this unit is deserves the 5 star rating.

Sentence (English): I'm a fan of Costco normally but my recent purchase was less than stellar.

I sure better be happy with this product, fingers crossed.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher works great and is nearly silent.
Comments (English): [ 3rd row is very functional! LOOK! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher works great and is nearly silent. We still can't believe how quiet the unit is. One thing about the installation is the water inlet is the size of a garden hose and not a 3/8 fitting. I did have to go back to the hardware store and purchase an installation hose kit that included the particular 90° fitting. My cabinet is a little short for the unit and all of the insulation that surrounds the exterior. There is a perforated hump area that I had to remove per instructions and the unit slid in easily on the dishwasher plastic tray. This tray has a lip on 3 sides that if there is ever a leak, it directs the water toward the front and you would see it on the floor in front of the unit. Slightly raising the legs for the irregularity of the floor and this plastic tray may have contributed to the tight fit with that extra little portion of insulation.As far as the function of this dishwasher it is great. I had coffee cups with tea residue/ stains and this dishwasher cleaned it off! The 3rd row is the reason I purchased this unit over others. It's very practical you can put cups and glasses on the top shelf! It has 2 horizontal rotating wash tubes that really get the inside of your cups and glasses on that top shelf clean. I like the top shelf silverware tray too with individual support for knives. I am able to keep my steak knives separate from the normal silverware which will help keep them sharp. The silverware basket has removable top inserts. I found it tedious placing every handle in its own slot in the standard silverware basket and these are easily removed. Unlike many dishwashers these days, there is a heated dry along with a fan heated dry! I have no regrets and very happy with my purchase. The cleaning, functionality, layout of the tines to support the dishes, and how quiet this unit is deserves the 5 star rating.

Sentence (English): We had an older Maytag washer that I had repaired and repaired and repaired.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher; Poor Customer Service ] || ---------------- || We had an older Maytag washer that I had repaired and repaired and repaired. After 12 years of service, "suddenly" it went to that place where all good dishwashers go when their time is up.For various reasons, we needed a dishwasher fast! The Bosh 800 was not the dishwasher we intended to buy; we targeted the 500. Unfortunately, no one in our local area had ANY Bosch dishwashers…except this particular model…and it was almost an hour away. For the difference in price, this had better be a good dishwasher.I am happy to say, it has performed great! After having a 12-year-old dishwasher, it took us a bit to get accustomed to the new technology and just how quiet the machine runs. Most of the time, I can't tell if it's on or off. Our dishes come out very clean.If I have a small critique, it's that the control display darkens when the door is closed. As a result, I cannot see a countdown of how much time is left in the cycle. Initially, I thought the display panel was faulty. Why have a cycle countdown display if it's only going to disappear when the door closes? But apparently that's the way it is. I wish there was a way to turn this on/off as the user desires. The red indicator light is supposed to make up for that, but it feels a little gimmicky.Now for the bad. If you love 2023 Customer Service, you'll love calling Bosch's support line. I do not and, therefore, I did not. Because I thought our display panel was faulty, I called 4 different times. The wait times were lengthy. Two of the four times, I hung up after waiting 30 minutes! (What was I thinking! ) The two representatives I did speak to were just not helpful.All in all: great dishwasher; poor customer service

As a result, I cannot see a countdown of how much time is left in the cycle. Initially, I thought the display panel was faulty. Why have a cycle countdown display if it's only going to disappear when the door closes? But apparently that's the way it is. I wish there was a way to turn this on/off as the user desires. The red indicator light is supposed to make up for that, but it feels a little gimmicky.Now for the bad. If you love 2023 Customer Service, you'll love calling Bosch's support line. I do not and, therefore, I did not. Because I thought our display panel was faulty, I called 4 different times. The wait times were lengthy. Two of the four times, I hung up after waiting 30 minutes! (What was I thinking!) The two representatives I did speak to were just not helpful.All in all: great dishwasher; poor customer service
